title: AgentBinding - a one-time binding of a block to an agent key (Section 8)
description: A block has EXACTLY ONE binding; a second one is invalid - this makes the block non-reincarnatable and a stolen form useless. Uniqueness cannot be derived from a single document and is checked separately. agent.key proves continuity, not identity: anyone can generate a key.

signatures.description: Signed by the agent itself: no contact with the issuer is required at binding time.
